property_summary: For any caller and any sendMoney arguments, only the contract deployer (owner) can later withdraw all funds via withdrawAll; the mutant inverts onlyOwner allowing non-owners to withdraw, so there exist inputs where a non-owner can withdraw and thus the property is violated.
change_summary: Invert onlyOwner require to require(msg.sender != owner), allowing only non-owners to pass the check and thus changing who can call withdrawAll.
